meta.name: brand-landingpage
meta.description: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI, are working at component level, building a multi-page app, or restyling with known design tokens — use frontend-design instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行品牌访谈,生成可直接部署的落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要一个有品牌调性的落地页但还没定视觉方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a brand interview and generate a deployable landing page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a brand-oriented landing page but don't have a visual direction.

howto.what: 它会先问你产品、品牌感觉和视觉偏好(颜色、字体、形状),再用 Stitch 生成桌面落地页,在浏览器里打开给你看,按你的反馈改稿或出变体,最后打包成可直接部署的 HTML 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、设计或搭一个落地页、主页、营销页,且没有既定视觉方向时接管;若已有设计稿或需要仪表盘类界面,则改用 frontend-design。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品落地页,先问我品牌颜色和字体
say.note: 会先进入品牌访谈,约 10 个问题

say.text: 这次用深色模式,字体偏现代
把首屏标题改一下,再生成一版看看
say.note: 走定向编辑或变体生成

howto.what_en: It interviews you on product, brand feel and visual direction, then generates a desktop landing page with Stitch, opens it in your browser, iterates on feedback, and delivers a deployment-ready HTML bundle.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create, design or build a landing page, homepage or marketing page without an established visual direction. With an existing mockup or a dashboard UI, use frontend-design.

say_en.text: Build a landing page for my product and ask me about brand colors and fonts
say_en.note: Starts the brand interview, about 10 questions

say_en.text: Use dark mode and a modern font this time
Change the hero headline and generate another version
say_en.note: Runs a targeted edit or a variant
